release_title: MAI Realtime 1: Leading voice AI at $0.01 per audio minute

models.name: MAI Realtime 1

pricing.note: 基础 speech-to-speech 用量 $0.01/音频分钟；推理另按 token 计费（输入 $1/M、输出 $5/M）

models.capability_summary: 微软官方定位：MAI Realtime 1 是其首个 speech-to-speech 模型，为真实企业场景的自然流动对话而建，基础用量 $0.01/音频分钟，支持噪声下的指令识别、连接企业系统与工具实操、以及用提示词调整人设。本次收录 3 项评测，其中 2 项给出绝对分值（Big Bench Audio 98.9%、τ-Voice 57.5%，均为微软内部评测口径），Dynamics 365 Contact Center evaluations 仅被点名、未公布分值。

locator.heading: MAI Realtime 1: Leading voice AI at $0.01 per audio minute
locator.table: Big Bench Audio score vs. price
locator.quote_snippet: MAI Realtime 1 from internal evaluation, 98.9% at $1.3548 per hour

protocol.harness: 微软内部评测（图表注释：MAI Realtime 1 from internal evaluation）

benchmark_evidence.notes: 该页服务端 HTML 的 <table> 计数为 0，本行数值取自 base64 编码的 <block-widget> 模板内发布方自带的数据常量（PTS 数组），浏览器端渲染为带 caption 的数据表，属机读 DOM 行、非位图/OCR，故记 verified。图表注释原文「Source: Artificial Analysis (competitor scores and costs); MAI Realtime 1 from internal evaluation, 98.9% at $1.3548 per hour」——自家列是微软内部评测、竞品列是 Artificial Analysis，两者协议不同，不可直接横比，comparison_scope=only_same_protocol。同图竞品列（Artificial Analysis 口径，按口径不拆独立行）：Gemini 3.8 Live 91.7%、Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (High) 97.7%、Grok Voice 2.0 97.2%、Eleven Realtime v1 Max 98.8%、GPT-Live-1 (Astra, medium) 90.1%、GPT-Realtime-2.1 High 95.8%。成本为「每小时输入音频」，按固定 40 题 Big Bench Audio 子集归一化（页面未说明 98.9% 本身是否也只跑这 40 题，故 benchmark_variant 留 null）。官方模型页 microsoft.ai/models/mai-realtime-1/ 的 data-count-target="98.9" 可二次印证。

locator.heading: MAI Realtime 1: Leading voice AI at $0.01 per audio minute
locator.quote_snippet: MAI Realtime 1 from internal evaluation, 57.5% at $1.3548 per hour

protocol.harness: 微软内部评测（图表注释：MAI Realtime 1 from internal evaluation）

benchmark_evidence.notes: 数值取自 base64 编码的 <block-widget> 模板内发布方自带数据常量（机读 DOM 行，非位图/OCR）。图表注释原文「Cost is normalized to one hour of input audio. Full-duplex models only. Source: Artificial Analysis (competitor scores and costs); MAI Realtime 1 from internal evaluation, 57.5% at $1.3548 per hour」——图表口径为全双工模型，x 轴是每小时输入音频成本。自家列是微软内部评测、竞品列是 Artificial Analysis，协议不同不可直接横比，comparison_scope=only_same_protocol。同图竞品列（Artificial Analysis 口径，按口径不拆独立行）：Phonic 1 (High) 79.9%、GPT-Live-1 (Astra, medium) 74.5%、Grok Voice 3.0 71.6%、Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (High) 68.6%、GPT-Live-1 (Sol, low) 59.3%、Qwen Audio 3.0 Realtime Plus 54.6%、Eleven Realtime v1 Max 47.6%、Qwen Audio 3.0 Realtime Flash 35.9%、Gemini 3.8 Live 30.1%。正文另称 MAI Realtime 1 在该图上位于性能—价格 Pareto 前沿，未印坐标绝对值，属相对论断不另建行。

locator.heading: About these results
locator.quote_snippet: Competitive performance: MAI Realtime 1 was evaluated against GPT Realtime 2.1 using public benchmarks including Big Bench Audio and τ-Voice, alongside Dynamics 365 Contact Center evaluations.

benchmark_evidence.notes: new-benchmark: dynamics-365-contact-center-eval（微软内部产品评测集，题集与判分流程未公开，外部无法复跑）。官方仅在页脚点名该评测集，正文只给与 GPT Realtime 2.1 的相对结论（"Our model outperforms GPT Realtime 2.1 on quality, speed, and price across public benchmarks and Microsoft product evaluations."），全站未发布任何绝对分值，故记 score_status=not_reported / value=null，不可与公开基准横比；若官方后续补数，走 revisions[] 追加，不得直接改写。
